generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential from 1, unique per table; never NULL. For VARCHAR PK columns that are also enum-constrained (Ref_*_Type), draw the PK from the enum pool (cycling to fill the table size) instead of a fresh code.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Uniformly pick an existing parent key from the FINAL parent key set (after dedup and rule application).
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_short: Random alphanumeric string 3-20 chars; boundary/near-variant values only for columns with an explicit per_column_exceptions entry.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_name: Random name from a small pool; duplicate share 20-50% only where a duplicates_for_distinct exception lists the column.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_email: local@domain.tld; duplicate share 20-50% only where listed.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_phone: Random digits with separators; duplicate share only where listed.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_code: For each column with an enum exception draw only from that enum pool (no case variants). For columns listed under comparison_boundary, inject the boundary multiset into some non-NULL rows and leave the remaining rows to the enum pool or generic sampling; do not emit a case variant that is not in the enum pool.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_description: Random short phrase; duplicate share 20-50% only where listed.
generic_sampling_rules.datetime: Random timestamp in 2017-01-01..2018-03-31; duplicate share 20-50% only where listed.
generic_sampling_rules.decimal_amount: Uniform in [500, 1500] with 4 decimals; never negative.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Every nullable column receives at least one NULL row per instance and a NULL share that follows the compact database's null_rate for that column (0.0 for a non-null column). NOT NULL columns are never NULL. Rules (range, enum, order, boundary, duplicate, group, tie) constrain non-NULL operands only; a planted NULL is never replaced.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For columns named under comparison_boundary, inject the listed multiset of target values into some rows; the remaining rows are filled by the generic sampling rule for that column.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_string: For columns named under comparison_boundary, inject the listed multiset (each literal and its listed case variant) into some rows; the remaining rows are filled by the generic sampling rule for that column. A value that is not in the enum pool is not injected into an enum-constrained column.
generic_sampling_rules.like_near_variant: For columns named under like_near_variant, inject the exact literal, one case variant, and one trailing-space variant; the union of the comparison_boundary and like_near_variant multisets is injected into the same column.
generic_sampling_rules.fk_order: Parents fully materialized and deduped first; children draw FKs from the final parent key set.
generic_sampling_rules.rule_pk_safety: No tie/group-size/duplicate/boundary/enum rule ever targets a primary-key column; after any value rule a PK dedup pass runs.
generic_sampling_rules.rule_execution_order: Parents before children. Within a table: NULL planting first, then enum/code pools, then boundary, then duplicate share, then group sizes, then tie, then date-order correction (always adjust the end value; when the end column also has a duplicate-share rule, adjust the start value instead), then FK draw. Rules skip positions already NULL and never overwrite a NULL.

targets: 20-50% duplicate share computed over non-NULL rows
groups of size 1, 2 and >=3 computed over non-NULL rows
parent rows without children by drawing child FKs from a strict subset of parent keys
child rows with NULL FK only where the column is listed in null_targets
